text:
sara: Heads-up: onboarding helios-48k-int4 uncovered a deterministic "ghost-gap" when streaming immediately after a large prefill. Repro on two nodes (gpu-eu-2 / gpu-us-4).
joon: ghost-gap = missing contiguous tokens? or misordered?
sara: missing contiguous tokens ~ length 6-12 near the prefill tail. Generation resumes after the gap. Not a decoding bug.
kelsey: which sequence lengths? any pattern?
sara: triggered when prefill is near top of window (44k-48k), often when prefill_length % 1536 in that band. More frequent with rotary_scale!=1.0.
rory: does it reproduce across quant modes?
sara: float32 clean. int8 rare. int4 deterministic on our test rigs.
joon: smells like an async memcpy / compact ordering issue in the int4 path. Can you share the short repro?
sara: minimal loop: 
for L in 44200 45600 47104 48320; do 
  python reproduce_prefill.py --model helios-48k-int4 --prefill $L --quant int4 --stream true 
done

kelsey: logs (filtered):
[2026-07-21T11:08:12Z] prefill complete len=47104 shard=1
[2026-07-21T11:08:12Z] kv: epoch=17 fp=0x2ac9
[2026-07-21T11:08:12Z] transition->stream_start
[2026-07-21T11:08:12Z] stream recv tokens 47096..47102
[2026-07-21T11:08:12Z] ERROR dropped tokens 47103..47112 (len=10)
[2026-07-21T11:08:12Z] resumed at 47113

joon: epoch bump? fingerprint diff?
sara: recorded small snapshot: {prefill_epoch:17, stream_epoch:18, prefill_fp:"0x2ac9", stream_fp:"0x2ac9"} 
joon: epoch increment but same fp -> buffer swap with identical bytes. That aligns with index remap/race.
kelsey: quick canary: try env KV_PREFILL_EVENT_SYNC=1 (signals an event before host transition) or KV_PREFILL_BARRIER=1 (full host sync).
sara: KV_PREFILL_BARRIER=1 eliminated the gap. Event-based sync (KV_PREFILL_EVENT_SYNC=1) also fixed it with minimal perf impact.
rory: good. So root cause is missing cudaEvent record / wait between compact copy and host-side handshake. int4 path uses additional streams/kernels and the event wasn't recorded on the producer stream.
joon: action items: (1) add event-record+wait in int4 prefill before stream_start; (2) audit all int4 async mempaths for missing event records; (3) add small regression test to onboarding checklist that runs loop over edge lengths; (4) telemetry: capture rotary_scale, quant_mode, prefill_epoch, shard_id on handshake logs.
sara: opened INF-3410 with logs, repro, and a small PR that gates KV_PREFILL_EVENT_SYNC behind runtime flag for canary. Canary deploy scheduled.
kelsey: add a runtime assert that logs when prefill_epoch != stream_epoch to capture live failures.
sara: added the assert + extra telemetry.
rory: I'll run nsight on gpu-eu-2 tomorrow to get timeline. If event sync fixes perf we can make it permanent; otherwise we'll prefer a per-kernel event record instead of host barrier.
joon: also add a short synthetic to the model-onboard checklist: "quant long-prefill handshake race check".
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled 2026-07-21T16:00Z by sara.
sara: monitoring canary now; will report perf impact and any residuals.
kelsey: thanks y'all. Good catch. :thumbsup:
